topic: Organizing a Successful Research Symposium: Highlighting Undergraduate Research
title: Organizing a Successful Research Symposium: Highlighting Undergraduate Research
session_title: Organizing a Successful Research Symposium: Highlighting Undergraduate Research
abstract: This workshop will detail the planning of a research poster symposium and the benefits it can offer to your student chapter and students. We will discuss strategies on attracting a high attendance of students and faculty and ensuring a valuable experience for all attendees. If time permits, there will also be a discussion on do’s and don’ts of making a research poster. The winner of Purdue AIChE’s poster symposium will also be speaking on her experience. This will be useful for student chapters looking to organize new events and current students interested or participating in research.
